selection.note: The shadow criterion and federated receipt architecture were established before this branch-only receipt run completed; this is not a post-selected historical failure case.

independent_deadline_preflight.note: Deadlines preserve Newsletter's strict age > threshold semantics by placing Proof Spine's inclusive valid_until transition one microsecond after the local boundary. Editorial deadline deliberately excludes Airlock because Airlock has its own evidence node.

historical_expected_outcome_before_sourc.note: This was the correct derivation under the proof contract that existed when sample 001 was first preserved. It is retained as lineage rather than silently rewritten.

later_contract_hardening.trigger: A shadow branch can drift from current Newsletter main while still executing green local checks, so current-health applicability must itself be proven.
later_contract_hardening.note: Sample 001 remains valid evidence that the public receipt producer actually ran and that all five Newsletter-local checks passed on its checkout. It is no longer accepted as specificity evidence for current production health because that receipt predates source-alignment attestation. This is intentional anti-zombie behavior, not a retroactive claim that the original checks failed.

claim_boundary: This sample proves that a prospective, public-safe Newsletter receipt was actually produced from live project-native health checks and preserved with exact artifact/content digests. Under the hardened contract it does not establish current production health because source alignment to current main was not attested. It also does not prove that the current private Hub consumer executed successfully against this receipt or that Proof Spine adds unique operational value beyond existing Newsletter health checks.
